title: History of Space Exploration
text: Space exploration began in earnest with the launch of Sputnik 1 by the Soviet Union in 1957, the first artificial satellite. Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space in 1961. NASA's Apollo 11 mission landed the first humans on the Moon in 1969. Since then, space exploration has expanded to include space stations (such as the International Space Station), robotic Mars rovers, and private spaceflight companies.
